description: React component for creating and editing invoices, including form handling, calculations, and integration with Redux actions and external APIs.

classes.name: useStyles
classes.description: Hook for generating Material-UI styles used in the component.

methods.name: Invoice
methods.description: Main React functional component for invoice creation/editing, managing state, effects, and rendering the invoice form.

methods.name: handleDateChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the invoice due date.

methods.name: handleRates
methods.description: Handles changes to the tax rate input.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles updates to individual invoice item fields.

methods.name: handleAddField
methods.description: Adds a new item row to the invoice.

methods.name: handleRemoveField
methods.description: Removes an item row from the invoice.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating an invoice.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Fetches the current total invoice count from the server to generate invoice number.
